artifacts.title: MSSQL IMPERSONATE to BadSuccessor dMSA and PTH admin (Eighteen)
artifacts.starting_access: no credentials on a Windows Server 2025 Active Directory host
artifacts.outcome: eighteen/administrator via BadSuccessor dMSA and pass-the-hash
transferable_properties: MSSQL IMPERSONATE privilege can switch execution context to other SQL users
spray a recovered password across enumerated users with netexec
BadSuccessor abuses CreateChild over an OU to impersonate Administrator via dMSA
chisel needs sudo to forward low ports like Kerberos 88 and SMB 445
sync Kerberos clock to UTC first then set the time to avoid skew
getST.py -dmsa previous keys rc4_hmac holds the impersonated user's NT hash

observations: user has IMPERSONATE privilege over other SQL users

hypotheses.statement: the IMPERSONATE privilege lets us act as appdev to extract hashes

selected_action.intent: connect to MSSQL and abuse IMPERSONATE to act as appdev

evidence.summary: connected to MSSQL as kevin, used EXECUTE AS LOGIN to impersonate appdev, and extracted an admin password hash

observations: admin hash extracted and cracked offline

hypotheses.statement: the recovered password works for a domain user over WinRM

selected_action.intent: crack the admin hash and spray the password across domain users

evidence.summary: cracked the admin password and used it to log in over WinRM as adam.scott, obtaining the user flag

observations: adam.scott is in the IT group with CreateChild over OU=Staff
BadSuccessor can create a dMSA that impersonates Administrator

hypotheses.statement: a dMSA created via BadSuccessor yields the Administrator NT hash

selected_action.intent: run BadSuccessor to create a dMSA impersonating Administrator, then getST.py for the ticket

evidence.summary: created a dMSA with BadSuccessor, tunneled Kerberos with chisel, and obtained the Administrator NT hash from getST.py -dmsa

observations: the NT hash can be used for pass-the-hash over WinRM

hypotheses.statement: pass-the-hash with the Administrator hash yields a shell as eighteen/administrator

selected_action.intent: connect with evil-winrm using the Administrator NT hash

evidence.summary: connected as eighteen/administrator via pass-the-hash and obtained the root flag
